Outcome: Done when: 14 days on the shared stack with no rollback; the adversarial suite green on every release in that period; TI's editors published at least one story and the monitors delivered daily; the parity report has no unexplained difference; the cost per day is recorded for the cost model (PPY-04ce84). Then, with Ryan's approval, retire TI's dedicated Amplify app, backend stack and distribution (delete after a final export kept in S3), and update the TI repository to say it is a tenant.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): TI repository docs, the old stack (deletion with approval), docs.

Scenario: TI's old backend is retired only after the green period
    Given 14 days without rollback and a final export stored
    When Ryan approves the retirement
    Then the old stack is deleted and TI is served only by the shared stack

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-e51189, PPY-0c4b55. Blocks PPY-8ca9a7. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-32b4c5.

Testing: Checklist with evidence on the issue.
Rollout: Operation.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: deleting the old backend removes the rollback. Mitigation: final export plus a 14-day wait.

Releasable on its own: no (operation).
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
